title: Liquor rules for nonprofit fundraising auctions
summary: As of the September 9, 2026 meeting, staff will seek written confirmation on whether a nonprofit tax form can serve as proof of nonprofit status. " A restaurant gift certificate that includes liquor may not be auctioned.

timeline.text: The department said nonprofits may auction a wine country trip, but not a restaurant gift certificate that includes liquor.
Staff will seek written confirmation on whether a nonprofit tax form can be used as proof of nonprofit status.
